falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $108,000 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout to new all-time highs would invalidate the HOLD/bottom-formation thesis and indicate the August 2024-style bottom pattern is not repeating

falsification_conditions.condition: Total crypto market cap (excluding BTC) drops below $850 billion
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A collapse in altcoins while BTC holds would signal a flight-to-safety regime, not the broad-based accumulation bottom the pattern match implies

falsification_conditions.condition: Coinbase premium index turns negative for 5 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained US selling pressure would contradict the accumulation phase expected at a bottom and suggest institutional distribution instead

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
